About the Scholarship

NucPhys is the Erasmus Mundus master in nuclear physics delivered by a Spanish-led consortium including the universities of Sevilla, Barcelona, UCM Madrid, Salamanca and European partners such as Université Paris-Saclay and TU Darmstadt. The next application round is expected to close in mid-December 2026, in line with recent cycles.

OpportunityNucPhys – Erasmus Mundus Master in Nuclear Physics
HostNucPhys Consortium
LocationSevilla (multi-country mobility), Spain
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
StipendErasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students:
Application Deadline15 December 2026
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

NucPhys is the Erasmus Mundus master in nuclear physics delivered by a Spanish-led consortium including the universities of Sevilla, Barcelona, UCM Madrid, Salamanca and European partners such as Université Paris-Saclay and TU Darmstadt. The next application round is expected to close in mid-December 2026, in line with recent cycles.

Programme Highlights

  • Specialised two-year nuclear physics master with lab and research placements
  • Application rounds historically close in mid-December for the following September
  • Consortium includes leading European nuclear-physics facilities
  • Graduates proceed to doctoral research and detector/instrumentation careers

Who Should Apply

Physics graduates with nuclear or particle physics coursework are the target group; English documentation follows the consortium's checklist.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs covered plus a monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Check the application-procedure page on the NucPhys site for the exact December cut-off and submit through the online form. Key deadline information: Mid-December 2026 (expected) — confirm the exact date on the official application-procedure page.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About NucPhys Consortium

The NucPhys consortium delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Nuclear Physics, coordinated from Spain with universities and research centres across Europe specialised in subatomic physics and instrumentation.

Official website: https://www.emm-nucphys.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 15 December 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
